info.name: LMS — Syllabus: Chapters & Topics (v1)
info.description:
Teacher/student APIs for the syllabus chapter + topic tree (the `content` module).

**Roles & scoping:**
- **List (POST /content/get)** — STUDENTS are auto-scoped server-side to their own class + section (they only need to send `subject_id`; any class/section they send is ignored). TEACHERS/admins filter explicitly by `standard_id`, `section_id`, `subject_id`.
- **Create / update / delete** — used by the teacher syllabus screen. Chapters are created one at a time (may start with no topics); topics are just a name (content optional).

The single-item create endpoints (`POST /content/chapter`, `POST /content/topic`) were added for the app's syllabus editor — distinct from the heavier `POST /content/upload` bulk content importer (which requires full topic content + supports image/PDF). Auth: Sanctum bearer token in `authToken`.

request.description:
Paginated chapters (each with its `topics[]`), ordered by `order` then `id`.

- **Teacher/admin:** send `standard_id`, `section_id`, `subject_id` to scope to one class+subject.
- **Student:** the server forces the scope to the student's own class+section — just send `subject_id` (other filters are ignored). Returns 404 if the student record is missing.

Create a single chapter (no topics required). Idempotent on (organization, standard, section, subject, name) — re-sending the same name returns the existing chapter. `description` is optional. Returns the chapter with an empty/loaded `topics[]`.
Update a chapter's name + description. Scoped to the caller's organization; 404 if not found.
Delete a chapter and all of its topics (and any associated topic files). Scoped to the caller's organization; 404 if not found.
Create a single topic under an existing chapter. `topic_content` is optional (syllabus topics are usually just a name). The chapter must belong to the caller's organization; 404 otherwise.
Update a topic's name + content. Image/PDF can also be sent as multipart on this endpoint. Scoped to the caller's organization via the parent chapter; 404 if not found.
Delete a single topic (and any associated files). Scoped to the caller's organization via the parent chapter; 404 if not found.

Heavier bulk importer: create multiple chapters each with multiple topics in one call. Unlike the syllabus Create Topic endpoint, here every topic requires `topic_content`; topics may also carry an `image` / `pdf` file (send as multipart in that case).
